declarations.description:
A vertical list of `c2-list-item` rows with single or multiple selection. The list owns the selection: it reads the
`value` of the clicked row, updates its own `value` (a `;`-separated list in the attribute, an array in the property)
and pushes the selected state down to every row through context, so rows never need a `selected` attribute of
their own when they live inside a list.

Keyboard: the list is a `listbox` with a roving `tabindex`. Arrow Up/Down move between enabled rows, Home/End jump to
the first/last, Enter and Space select the focused row, and typing letters jumps to the next row starting with them.

Besides rows, the default slot accepts `<hr>` dividers and `<h1>`–`<h6>` group headings; both are styled by the
`__divider` and `__heading` tokens and skipped by selection and keyboard.
declarations.name: List

cssProperties.description: Scrolls when the rows are taller than this.
cssProperties.name: --c2-list--max-height

slots.description: The rows: `c2-list-item` elements (or wrappers whose first child is a `c2-list-item`), plus `<hr>` dividers and heading elements.
slots.name: default

members.name: value
members.description: Selected values. Written as `value="a;b"` in markup, read as `['a', 'b']` from the property.

members.name: data
members.description: The `data` of every selected row, in `value` order. Not an attribute.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Dims the whole list and ignores clicks and keyboard.

members.name: multiple
members.description: Allow several rows to be selected; clicking a selected row deselects it.

members.name: required
members.description: Keep at least one row selected: clicking the only selected row does nothing.

members.name: focusedItem
members.description: The row that currently holds the roving tabindex.

members.name: items
members.description: Slotted rows, in DOM order (dividers and headings excluded).

members.name: syncRows
members.description:
Mirrors the selection onto the rows: `data`, the roving tabindex, and `joined-before` / `joined-after` on adjacent
selected rows so `c2-list-item` can square the corners between them and a run of selected rows reads as one block.

members.name: select
members.description: Applies a user selection of `value` (toggle in `multiple` mode) and fires `selection-change`.

members.name: syncPaddingClasses
members.description: Flush lists (no vertical padding) let the first and last rows take the list's corner radius.

members.name: _initComponent
members.description: private function used for demo project in some edge case need to refresh component

events.name: selection-change
events.description: Fired after the user changes the selection. `detail.value` is the array of selected values, `detail.data` the matching `data` of each row.
